headline: Nvidia board moves to oust Jensen Huang over reported affairs
snippet: Fortune reported that Nvidia's board was moving to remove CEO Jensen Huang after reports of personal relationships, including one with a person alleged to be linked to Chinese intelligence.

headline: Nvidia 8-K: CEO Jensen Huang resigns; CFO Colette Kress named interim CEO
snippet: Nvidia's filing says Huang stepped down as president, CEO and director effective immediately. CFO Colette Kress becomes interim CEO while remaining CFO, and the board has started a search for a permanent CEO.

headline: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO; Colette Kress named interim chief
snippet: Nvidia named CFO Colette Kress interim CEO after Jensen Huang resigned. Harvey C. Jones becomes the company's first board chair.

headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amid alleged affair
snippet: ABC News reported Huang's resignation followed disclosures about personal conduct, including an alleged relationship with a person reported to be a spy. The allegations are reported, not confirmed.

headline: Kress to lead Nvidia on interim basis after Huang's resignation
snippet: CNN reported that CFO Colette Kress will serve as interim leader while the board searches for a permanent CEO.

headline: Why did Jensen Huang resign, and who is Colette Kress?
snippet: An explainer on the circumstances of Huang's departure and the background of interim CEO Colette Kress, Nvidia's long-serving CFO.

headline: Nvidia falls about 14% after report of SEC accounting probe
snippet: Shares fell about 14% on Friday after Reuters reported, citing two people briefed on the matter, that the SEC is examining Nvidia's accounting practices. The SEC declined to comment. The report is unconfirmed.

headline: Nvidia shares plunge in broad AI tech selloff
snippet: AI-linked stocks sold off sharply on Friday; reports put the Nasdaq Composite down about 5% and the S&P 500 down nearly 4%, with Nvidia among the hardest hit.

headline: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO days after resignation
snippet: Nvidia's board reinstated Huang as CEO and returned him to the board about eleven days after he stepped down.

headline: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO; stock jumps 31%
snippet: Nvidia shares closed up about 31% after the board reinstated Huang. The board said it had received input from senior federal officials on potential national security concerns.

headline: Huang returns as Nvidia CEO after White House pressure, sources say
snippet: CNN reported, citing sources, that the reinstatement followed pressure from the White House, with Vice President JD Vance working with Huang and the board.

headline: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
snippet: CBS News reported the board's decision to bring Huang back as chief executive and director.

headline: Nvidia shares fall more than 5% as Huang comeback rally cools
snippet: Nvidia gave back part of Monday's gain, falling more than 5% the day after Huang's reinstatement.

headline: Huang tells staff Nvidia doesn't need a succession plan
snippet: At his first employee meeting since returning, Huang struck a remorseful tone, apologised, and said the company does not need a succession plan.
